questions.questionText: Which statement about an ionic bond is correct?

options.text: It is a strong electrostatic attraction between cations and anions.
It is a strong electrostatic attraction between protons and electrons.
It is a weak electrostatic attraction between cations and anions.
It is a weak electrostatic attraction between protons and electrons.

Boron nitride is a compound of the elements boron and nitrogen.
It has a similar structure to diamond.
What is likely to be a property of boron nitride?

options.text: It is used as a lubricant.

questions.questionText: Which statement defines the term molecular formula?

options.text: a formula that shows the total number of atoms in a molecule
a formula that shows the total number of elements in a molecule
a formula that shows the arrangement of different atoms in a molecule
a formula that shows the number and type of different atoms in a molecule

questions.questionText:
Blue copper(II) sulfate crystals are heated in air until they turn into a white powder.
The powder is allowed to cool and after a few days it starts to turn blue.
Why does the white powder start to turn blue?

options.text: Carbon dioxide in the air reacts with the powder to form copper(II) carbonate.
The powder reacts with water in the air to form copper(II) hydroxide.
The white copper compound is slowly oxidised.
Water is absorbed from the air and causes the reaction to reverse.
